quality_gate: Use the six-digit official local-government code as the stable identity and verify the corresponding five-digit standard area code.
Treat current core-city membership and prefectural-capital status as sourced classifications, not as name-based inference.
Exclude all Phase 13 designated cities from the Phase 14 execution universe and fail validation on any overlap.
Verify the current comprehensive plan identity and effective period from an official municipal source before source_inventory_complete.
Verify official implementation, progress, evaluation, or explicit unavailability routes without inventing a layer that the municipality does not publish separately.
Verify official budget and settlement entry points while keeping proposal, enacted initial budget, supplementary budget, execution, and settlement states separate.
Preserve plan version, fiscal year, reporting year, measurement year, source precision, denominator, and organization boundaries.
Do not promote indexed material to Reviewed; Phase 14 remains source inventory and Phase 15 performs record-level review.
Do not infer policy achievement, causal attribution, or cross-city comparability from source availability or municipal self-evaluation.
Do not rank municipalities unless a later methodology independently verifies definition, unit, period, denominator, and aggregation-scope comparability.
